decisions.reason: Correctly ties top-level ESM in plugin/lib/client.js to the all-or-nothing classic-script combo compile failure (1:1), explains zero entries register, and identifies typert-registry as the first-awaited innocent victim; scopes ESM invalidity to the classic-script context.

Bisects the patch insert rows, gives an equivalent static classic-script check (grep for leading top-level import/export, noting a correct bundle never starts with import), and fully describes the ModuleLoader.load({id, factory}) bundle with require-based React and apply/inject exports.

Explains foreign-entry ownership and apply-time rejection and recommends slots.inject, but never shows the deferred inject(name, () => register(...)) form (bare-ish mention), and wrongly claims registrants must not pass the slot name, contradicting the name/id/order-only rule.

States combo is assembled once at boot with no watch/rebuild, gives full stop/restart/refresh/verify procedure, explains EADDRINUSE as the surviving orphaned node process holding the port, and names taskkill /PID /T /F.

Proposes per-bundle compile validation and culprit attribution at startup/combo failure instead of blaming the first awaited entry, plus an authoring checklist covering loader factory, host React, inject/apply, deferred slot usage, and Windows tree restart.

caps.reason: Final advice consistently requires the loader wrapper, slots.inject, no registrant kind/scope, and full host restarts; no affirmative contradictory recommendation.
